title: I cannot code, fortunately Claude can. Here is a short showcase of the early stages of my game: Plume.
author: BlrdGrylls
selftext:
**TL;DR Basically 100% vibecoded by Claude. Anything visual is still 100% hand-made by me. An early demo is up on itch and the steam page is also up!**

Making a game is something I always wanted to do, but always thought that learning to code was a daunting task. After messing around with vibecoding a bit, I figured that this could basically help me overcome that barrier, and allow me to focus on what I could do, like the art or sounds.

The game is made in Godot, and I was surprised to see that Claude can perfectly work with it.

A short alpha build is up on itch, which can be played in your browser for free. 

I'm curious what people think here, and I hope this is still "AI enough" for everyone, given it's only the code that is AI.

comments.author: Aggravating-Love9309

Open-sourcing a small tool I built. It's just Markdown — no runtime, no dependencies.



claude-kb gives an AI coding assistant (Claude Code) a compact \`kb/\` map of your project so it doesn't re-read the whole codebase each session — fewer tokens, faster, better performance. It also keeps itself updated as the code changes.



MIT licensed, works with any language. Issues & PRs welcome.

GitHub: [https://github.com/johnmungandiall/claude-kb](https://github.com/johnmungandiall/claude-kb)

X: [https://x.com/JohnMunagndi/status/2070339087589122384](https://x.com/JohnMunagndi/status/2070339087589122384)
